svg.aria-label: Core sample: a geological section through 4,957 GitHub contributions since Jun 2024, one rock bed per month, with merged upstream pull requests as fossils and founded repositories as crystals.
svg.text: Frontispiece · Section through the account of Zaid Ali Syed
Core sample, Jun 2024 to the present
4,957 contributions laid down one month per bed. Redrawn every night from the GitHub API.
fossil: a pull request merged into someone else's public code
bed thickness grows with the square root of contributions
